title: Fields and constructors
summary: What each account remembers, and starting it in a valid state.

steps.title: Fields
steps.say: Fields are an object's own variables. Team standard: field names end in `_`.

marks.label: subclasses can reach it; outside code can't

steps.title: The constructor
steps.say: The constructor runs on `new`. It has the class's name and no return type, and it sets every field.

marks.label: same name as the class, no return type

steps.title: Open BankAccount.java
steps.say: Press **Ctrl+P**, type `BankAccount` and press Enter. Quick Open finds any file by name, so you never have to dig through folders.
